name: CORE - Resolved Alert Spatial Rematch v1

parameters.query:
SELECT coalesce(a.raw_payload,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
  'schema_version',a.schema_version,
  'alert_id',a.alert_id,
  'source',a.source,
  'source_event_id',a.source_event_id,
  'category',a.category,
  'subtype',a.subtype,
  'status',a.status,
  'event_action',a.event_action,
  'title',a.title,
  'message',a.message,
  'priority',a.priority,
  'county',coalesce(nullif(a.county,''),nullif(a.location->>'county',''),nullif(r.county,'')),
  'municipality',coalesce(nullif(a.municipality,''),nullif(a.location->>'municipality',''),nullif(r.municipality,'')),
  'location',coalesce(a.location,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'label',coalesce(nullif(a.location->>'label',''),r.resolved_label),
    'address',coalesce(nullif(a.location->>'address',''),r.resolved_label),
    'municipality',coalesce(nullif(a.location->>'municipality',''),nullif(r.municipality,'')),
    'county',coalesce(nullif(a.location->>'county',''),nullif(r.county,'')),
    'state',coalesce(nullif(a.location->>'state',''),nullif(r.state,''),'NJ'),
    'longitude',ST_X(a.geom),
    'latitude',ST_Y(a.geom)
  )),
  'tags',a.tags,
  'click_url',a.click_url,
  'source_url',a.source_url,
  'observed_at',a.observed_at,
  'source_updated_at',a.source_updated_at,
  'received_at',a.received_at,
  'expires_at',a.expires_at,
  'metadata',coalesce(a.metadata,'{}'::jsonb),
  'search_text',trim(concat_ws(' ',nullif(a.search_text,''),nullif(r.municipality,''),nullif(r.county,'')))
) AS alert
FROM alerts a
JOIN geo_entity_resolutions r ON r.entity_type='ALERT' AND r.entity_id=a.id::text
WHERE a.geom IS NOT NULL
  AND a.received_at>=now()-interval '6 hours'
  AND a.status<>'RESOLVED'
  AND (a.expires_at IS NULL OR a.expires_at>now())
  AND r.status='RESOLVED'
  AND r.confidence>=0.85
  AND r.spatial_precision='ADDRESS_POINT'
  AND r.updated_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '__CMOS_ACTIVATED_AT__'
  AND coalesce(a.metadata#>>'{_cmos,spatial_rematch_version}','')<>'geo-v1'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM watch_items w
    WHERE w.active=true
      AND (w.starts_at IS NULL OR w.starts_at<=now())
      AND (w.expires_at IS NULL OR w.expires_at>now())
      AND (w.nearby_enabled=true OR nullif(w.municipality,'') IS NOT NULL)
  )
ORDER BY r.updated_at,a.id
LIMIT 50;

nodes.name: Send Resolved Alert to Central Watchlist Matcher

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p)
UPDATE alerts a
SET metadata=coalesce(a.metadata,'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
      '_cmos',coalesce(a.metadata->'_cmos','{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
        'spatial_rematch_version','geo-v1',
        'spatial_rematched_at',now()
      )
    )
FROM d
WHERE a.alert_id=d.p->>'alert_id'
RETURNING a.alert_id;
